thread.title: Bernstein: 10 Disruptive Forces In Payments For 2018

author: Wayne Duggan
title: Bernstein: 10 Disruptive Forces In Payments For 2018
text:
The Rose Portfolio Update With Double Digit Total Return For The 91 Holdings (Seeking Alpha) 
The world of payments is ripe for disruption, and Bernstein's Lisa Ellis recently outlined what she said are the top 10 disruptive forces in the payments business. There's much money to be made as the world transitions to the next era of payments, the analyst said. 
“Entering 2018, with most payment stocks near all-time highs and peak multiples, we believe that disruptive forces will dominate the narrative for the payments stocks." Trends To Watch 
Here’s a rundown of what Ellis said are the sectors top 10 disruptive forces. (See Ellis' track record here .) How To Play It 
With so many moving parts, it’s difficult to make predictions about how the payment space will evolve in 2018, but Ellis said at least a handful of companies are in a prime position to benefit. Bernstein’s top 10 disruptors in the payment space are: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd (NYSE: BABA )’s Alipay and Tencent’s WeChat Pay. Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN ) Pay and Apple Inc. (NASDAQ: AAPL ) Pay’s “checkout buttons.” Peer-to-peer payment competition.
